content: ASD-STE100 Issue 9 (2025-01-15): two parts - 53 writing rules in 9 sections plus a dictionary of ~900 approved words and ~1200 unapproved with alternatives. Copyright and trademark of ASD Brussels; the spec is free to download on request but redistribution is not granted. Conformance checking tooling is split: free partial tools (Thumbs Up STE Tool, online verb checker, STE-checker) versus commercial full checkers (Acrolinx, Congree, Boeing Simplified English Checker, ARDOS). No free tool certifies conformance; full checking is dictionary-dependent and commercial. Documented criticism: only ~36% of Issue-8 users were aerospace/defense, STE needs high English proficiency to apply, is often misapplied as a style-guide substitute, and should complement not replace a style guide.
